# Vendored Discord SDK

`discord-sdk.js` is the browser ESM bundle of `@discord/embedded-app-sdk` **2.5.0**, obtained from:

https://esm.sh/@discord/embedded-app-sdk@2.5.0/es2022/embedded-app-sdk.bundle.mjs

Upstream: https://github.com/discord/embedded-app-sdk

The SDK uses the MIT license. Its license is included as `DISCORD-LICENSE.txt`. The bundle includes the SDK’s runtime dependencies; see `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt` for their notices. This file is loaded only inside a Discord Activity. Browser play does not initialize the SDK.
